scope: All 26 GaTech 2023 publisher base tasks ("activities"): the 19 with publisher segmentation files (the backlog question's 19) plus 7 the publisher did not segment. Metadata, documentation and code only; no source arrays were read.
reads: Publisher README copy, paper XML, Code.zip members, converter sources, prior audits, the parsing-field inventory (interval counts per field; produced 2026-10-20 by contributor_tools/audit_probes/2026_10_20/check_gt23_task_coverage.py), inventory.json and RawData directory names. During exploration the first 400 bytes of one AB01 normal_walk_1 GroundFrame_GRFs.csv and Activity_Flag.csv were printed to read column headers; no values are used as evidence.

backward_travel.status: Facing is opposite to travel; the data reference defines +x as "the walking direction" while viewing the person "facing right". Needs D-GT23-C01-1.

heading_changes.status: The pelvis heading turns within the window; one forward axis per window is undefined. Needs D-GT23-C01-1.

no_forward_travel.status: No forward walking direction (in place, sideways or transfer). Needs D-GT23-C01-1.

overground_forward.status: Facing equals travel while walking forward; heading measured per stride from markers. CORE-04 stair strides: CoP progression and braking/propulsion checks were "unknown".

treadmill_forward.status: Fixed heading on the treadmill; facing equals travel. +x derivable from markers (CORE-04 v2 pelvis facing: braking/propulsion and CoP progression pass on level, incline and decline in AB01/AB06/AB13). Not stated by the publisher.

established: Activity definitions and segmentation rules: README lines 144-278; paper Methods (Ground reaction forces: 20 N steps, 50 N for treadmill running, feet assigned by marker/CoP matching; inverse dynamics NaN off plates).

Parsing file layout: README line 51 (rows = cycles, columns start/end time; optional types -> right_<type>, left_<type>). Field inventory confirms <leg>[_<type>] fields in all 778 non-empty files; 9 files are empty (AB05/AB10 running: README 108, 139; AB01 five stair descents: unexplained).
Activity_Flag.csv: per-sample on/off for left and right (paper Table 3; README line 29). Neither converter reads it.
Vertical GRF: Y up, positive support (README line 30; GT23-C02).

Horizontal GRF and global CoP: OpenSim global X/Z, which turn with the person (paper Table 3; gt23-source-frame-review). Converters assign ForceX/ForceZ directly to anterior/lateral (time converter lines 501-506; phase converter 794-835): unsupported.
Sideways sign: outward per leg (data reference, Signs and frames; D-GT21-C01-1 = B), once +x is known.

Converter CoP: calcn body frame with calcn origin (gt23-cop-and-joint-coordinate-review). The data reference defines CoP in the ground frame (+x forward, +y up); a foot-fixed frame rotates with the foot, so the current cop_* mapping is a frame mismatch, not only an origin note.

Joint sagittal signs under rule B: hip +1, knee -1, ankle +1 for angle, velocity and moment; powers +1 (sign survey; gt23-joint-sign-and-segment-evidence; CORE-04 GT23 pilot 0 wrong of 141 applied/suggested, independent rerun AB10/AB11 0 wrong).
Units and mass: GT23-C02, GT23-C03, GT23-C04 (kinetics blocked by D-GT23-C04-1).

converter_findings.finding: Keeps only the leg with more intervals per condition (tie: earlier start) and drops the other leg: 4948 of 13119 intervals, of which 498 are per-leg gait cycles (running, stairs) and 127 are hop contact intervals (README 274, 20 N contact; jump is classed as task windows, so these are not in the gait-cycle count). The rest are task-window activities whose left/right windows may be identical (probe P1); there ipsi is arbitrary.
converter_findings.fix: Emit each leg's source intervals with its reference_side; for whole-body windows identical on both legs (probe P1) emit reference_side none (contract: ipsi/contra name roles).

converter_findings.finding: One window per parsing file = envelope [min start, max end] over every interval field, so conditions in one file (sitting/standing, forward/backward, left/right-lead) are merged into one window; reference leg = first start. 90 recordings carry no source intervals (85 without parsing files, 5 with only empty ones) and are never exported.
converter_findings.fix: One observation per source interval (or per contiguous cycle chain), labelled by its field; continuous_recording for recordings without source intervals (after exclusion review).

converter_findings.finding: Fallback sit/stand and jump segmentation with LocoHub thresholds (600/400 N absolute, 25 deg/s) replaces source events when a file lacks left/right fields. Every sit_to_stand and jump file has source fields, so it should never fire; any output it produced is not source-defined.
normal_walk 2-0/2-5 (running per GroupTasks, plotting script and paper) and skip are labelled level_walking.
converter_findings.fix: Label from the publisher grouping (run; skip as its own variant family).

converter_findings.finding: Invented task_info: stairs height_m 0.15 (paper Table 1: 152 mm), step_number is the pass index, curb 0.15 m and step-up 0.20 m not found in local sources.
converter_findings.fix: Stair rise 0.152 m citing paper Table 1; rename pass index; drop curb/step-up heights unless Supplementary Table 1 states them.

converter_findings.finding: Global ForceX/ForceZ written as anterior/lateral (known; correction prepared, not run).
converter_findings.fix: Heading-projected +x per forward class; other classes per D-GT23-C01-1.

unsupported_mappings_left_explicit: Horizontal GRF and CoP for backward_travel, heading_changes and no_forward_travel activities (D-GT23-C01-1).
Horizontal GRF and CoP for forward classes until heading is measured per stride/window and checked (probe P2 covers contact only; heading reuse of the CORE-04 adapter is planned).
cop_* in the converter's calcn body frame (frame mismatch with the data reference).
Segment and pelvis angles (no publisher channel; local Link_Angle Euler YZX with a +pi/2 pelvis offset; seven AB02 normal_walk windows have oversized Transforms).
Moments and powers until D-GT23-C04-1 is answered and rescaling is reviewed.
turn_and_step event definition (README vs plotting script).
AB02 curb filename vs field type; weighted_walk speed (README 1.0 vs plotting 1.25 m/s).

AB07 treadmill recordings (dynamic_walk, incline_walk, normal_walk, walk_backward, weighted_walk, obstacle_walk) exist in RawData without parsing files; README lines 115-136 say these trials were removed (zero A/P force). Exclusion disposition needed before any continuous export.

probe_plan.P1: All 787 parsing files (708 KiB total): per condition, left vs right windows identical (max |diff| <= 0.0025 s), consecutive-interval contiguity, duration median; types cell contents.
probe_plan.P2: Selected recordings, GroundFrame_GRFs.csv columns time, LForceY_Vertical, RForceY_Vertical only: NaN fraction per leg inside the parsing envelope; for heel_strike and skip activities and every jump hop file, rising 20 N (50 N for normal_walk 2-0/2-5) crossing within 1 sample of each interval start, and a falling crossing inside it. One extra seeded hop file and one extra running file are always included.
probe_plan.P3: Selected recordings, Activity_Flag.csv: fraction of flag-on samples inside vs outside the parsing envelope, per leg.
probe_plan.bounds: One process, one thread, RLIMIT_AS 768 MiB, CSV files > 64 MiB refused (recorded not_checked), csv module, each file read whole into memory under the 64 MiB cap (not streamed), no writes outside docs/quality/audits/gt23-c01-probe.json.
probe_plan.launch: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 MPLBACKEND=Agg nice -n 19 ionice -c 3 python3 -m contributor_tools.guarded_launcher run <spec running this file with "probe">; needs the serial numerical slot.

native_pilot.prepared: gt23-known-pose-preparation.json: 13 AB01 model poses (neutral, +/-1 deg hip/knee/ankle each side), OpenSim marker/body stations; checker contributor_tools/check_gt23_known_pose.py.
native_pilot.status: not executed. The reviewed guarded launcher refuses MATLAB/native jobs until a reviewed native extension exists (guarded_launcher.py docstring).
native_pilot.what_it_adds: Model-level direction of hip/knee/ankle coordinates independent of the author plot code. CORE-04 marker tests already reproduced the signs from data in 7 gait conditions, so the native pilot is corroborating, not blocking for sagittal signs.

verification_plan: Contact missingness: per activity and leg, fraction of NaN vertical GRF inside parsing envelopes (P2); treadmill one-plate rule (README 93) incl. the running both-leg intervals and the decline left plate.

Non-gait activities: whether left/right windows are identical (P1) and whether Activity_Flag on-periods bound the parsing windows (P3) for squats, sit_to_stand, lift_weight, ball_toss, jumps, lunges, cutting, tire_run.
Heel-strike intervals: interval start equals a 20 N (50 N running) rising crossing on that leg within 1 sample, and a falling crossing (toe-off) exists inside each interval (P2).
